evals.prompt: We use shadcn charts. Migrate components/chart-area-interactive.tsx from Recharts to bklit and clean up whatever is no longer needed.
evals.expected_output: Inventory table listing chart-area-interactive.tsx (AreaChart via ChartContainer) and components/ui/chart.tsx as the wrapper; the area chart is classified needs-workaround because both Areas use stackId="a"; the agent asks overlap vs cumulative before converting, installs @bklit/area-chart and @bklit/legend, rewrites the chart with AreaChart/Area/Grid/XAxis/ChartTooltip/Legend imported from @/components/charts/..., resolves var(--color-*) from chartConfig, then deletes components/ui/chart.tsx and the recharts dependency only after confirming nothing else imports them.
expectations: Runs scripts/detect-recharts.mjs (or equivalent search) and presents an inventory table before editing
Classifies the chart as needs-workaround and names Area stackId as the reason
Asks the user how to handle the area stacking (overlap or cumulative) before converting
Installs with `npx shadcn@latest add @bklit/area-chart` (plus @bklit/legend for the legend)
Imports from @/components/charts/* and never from @bklitui/ui/charts
Replaces every var(--color-desktop) / var(--color-mobile) with the chartConfig colours (var(--chart-1) / var(--chart-2))
Converts the date strings to Date objects (local-day parsing such as `${date}T00:00:00`)
Maps type="natural" to curve={curveNatural} and the linearGradient defs to Area fillOpacity/gradientToOpacity (or a url fill with explicit stroke)
Uses ChartTooltip rows (or content) to show the 'Desktop'/'Mobile' labels and showCrosshair={false} for cursor={false}
Renders the legend with Legend/LegendItem/LegendMarker/LegendLabel outside the AreaChart
Does not invent props such as stacked on AreaChart, stackId on Area, or tickFormatter on XAxis
Deletes components/ui/chart.tsx and removes recharts only after verifying no remaining imports

evals.prompt: Replace the Recharts line chart in components/traffic-chart.tsx with bklit. Keep the same colours, labels and y-axis formatting.
evals.expected_output: A LineChart from @/components/charts/line-chart with two Line series (curve={curveMonotoneX}, stroke #2563eb and #16a34a), Grid, XAxis, YAxis formatValue reproducing the k formatter, ChartTooltip rows with 'Users'/'Sessions', and an HTML Legend; ResponsiveContainer removed and the 300px height preserved; date strings converted to Dates; @bklit/line-chart, @bklit/y-axis and @bklit/legend installed.
expectations: Classifies the chart as clean
Installs @bklit/line-chart, @bklit/y-axis and @bklit/legend
Removes ResponsiveContainer and keeps a 300px height (className="h-[300px]" or a sized wrapper)
Maps type="monotone" to curve={curveMonotoneX} imported from @visx/curve
Maps YAxis tickFormatter to YAxis formatValue
Keeps stroke colours #2563eb and #16a34a
Shows 'Users' and 'Sessions' (not the raw dataKeys) in the tooltip via rows and in a Legend
Converts the x values to Date objects
Does not use dot or type props on the bklit Line

evals.expected_output: BarChart with orientation="horizontal" (from Recharts layout="vertical"), xDataKey="browser", BarYAxis for the category labels, the hidden numeric XAxis omitted, Bar fill #6366f1 with lineCap={4}, ChartTooltip showCrosshair={false}, aspectRatio="4 / 3", margin.left widened for labels; only @bklit/bar-chart installed.
expectations: Maps layout="vertical" to orientation="horizontal" (not orientation="vertical")
Sets xDataKey="browser" on BarChart
Uses BarYAxis for the category labels instead of YAxis
Omits the hidden numeric XAxis
Maps radius={4} to lineCap={4}
Maps cursor={false} to showCrosshair={false}
Replaces ResponsiveContainer aspect={4 / 3} with aspectRatio="4 / 3"
Does not install @bklit/y-axis

evals.prompt: Move this project off Recharts entirely and onto bklit.
evals.expected_output: Inventory shows monthly-bars.tsx (BarChart, clean) and storage-treemap.tsx (Treemap, keep on Recharts). The agent explains bklit has no treemap (SunburstChart is a different chart type) and asks before changing chart type; converts MonthlyBars to BarChart/Bar/BarXAxis/Grid/ChartTooltip; leaves storage-treemap.tsx untouched and keeps the recharts dependency, telling the user a full removal is not possible without dropping or redesigning the treemap.
expectations: Classifies the Treemap as keep on Recharts with the reason that bklit has no treemap
Does not import or invent a bklit Treemap component
Mentions SunburstChart only as an optional, user-approved redesign
Converts monthly-bars.tsx to BarChart (default xDataKey "name" works) with Bar, BarXAxis, Grid and ChartTooltip
Uses lineCap="butt" or explicitly notes that bklit bars are rounded by default
Leaves storage-treemap.tsx unchanged
Does not remove recharts from package.json and explains why

evals.prompt: Can you convert components/height-weight.tsx to bklit? It's a height vs weight scatter plot.
evals.expected_output: The agent flags needs-workaround: XAxis type="number" with a height key, while bklit ScatterChart uses a time x scale. It explains the trade-off and asks before converting. The workaround keeps numeric heights as x (positions stay proportional), merges the Scatter data into ScatterChart data with xDataKey="height" and Scatter dataKey="weight", sorts by height, omits XAxis, sets showDatePill={false} and shows height/weight in ChartTooltip content, and keeps the y unit via YAxis formatValue. Keeping Recharts is offered as the alternative.
expectations: Classifies the chart as needs-workaround because of numeric x (XAxis type="number")
Asks the user before applying the workaround and offers keeping Recharts
Moves the series data onto ScatterChart data with xDataKey="height"
Uses Scatter dataKey="weight" (the y key)
Does not render bklit XAxis for the numeric axis (its labels would be dates)
Uses ChartTooltip content (or rows) plus showDatePill={false} to show real height values
Does not invent props such as xScale, xType or tickFormatter

evals.expected_output: PieChart with data mapped to { label: plan, value: seats, color: fill }, innerRadius={70}, padAngle converted from 2 degrees to radians, size={260}, one PieSlice per row, and PieCenter (defaultLabel e.g. "seats") replacing both the centre Label and the Tooltip; @bklit/pie-chart installed.
expectations: Classifies the chart as clean
Reshapes data to PieData { label, value, color } using nameKey/dataKey and the Cell fill colours
Renders one PieSlice index={i} per row
Converts paddingAngle={2} (degrees) to padAngle in radians (2 * Math.PI / 180)
Keeps innerRadius={70} in pixels and does not pass outerRadius
Replaces the centre Label with PieCenter
Imports from @/components/charts/pie-chart, pie-slice and pie-center

Maps stackId="a" on both bars to stacked on BarChart
Sets xDataKey="month"
Replaces var(--color-desktop)/var(--color-mobile) with var(--chart-1)/var(--chart-2)
Moves the tickFormatter (slice(0, 3)) into the data because BarXAxis has no formatter
Maps radius to lineCap and notes that [4,4,0,0] has no exact equivalent
Uses ChartTooltip rows for 'Desktop'/'Mobile' labels

expectations: Pivots row-per-subject data into metrics + one RadarData per series
Normalises values to 0–100 by dividing by 150 (the PolarRadiusAxis domain max)
Keeps the series colours #8884d8 and #82ca9d and the names Alice/Bob
